page.overview:
Who is Sareitha Tomares?

Sareitha Tomares was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Sareitha was a dark Tairen with inquisitive brown eyes and a square face. She looks slightly older than Nynaeve.

Sareitha is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Sareitha was 35 years old, she was born in 965 NE and went to the White Tower in 980 NE. After ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 998 NE.
